subject: Onboarding scheduling + contract inventory: procurement kickoff & technical demo
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.io>, Tom Huang <t.huang@acme.io>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme.io>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Onboarding scheduling + contract inventory: procurement kickoff & technical demo

Hi Tom / Sara —

Following up on our intake form — we'd love to schedule the procurement kickoff + short technical demo next week so we can align on contract owners, data handling, and required security artifacts. Proposed 60- to 75-minute block:

- 30 min: procurement + legal (contract owner + timeline)
- 30 min: technical demo (SE-led) + Q&A
- 15 min: security checklist & next steps (if needed)

Availability (PST) we have next week:
- Tue 11/17: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 11/18: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00

Cc'd Dylan (SE) and Marissa (Solutions lead) — can you confirm SE availability for those windows?

Attached: Redwood onboarding playbook and a short procurement checklist with typical timeline expectations. If you have a contract owner and security contact you'd like to include, please loop them in. Also let us know if you prefer separate security deep-dive vs. a single combined session.

Thanks — happy to coordinate calendar invites once we have a preferred slot.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Playbook_v2.docx, Procurement_Checklist.pdf
From: Tom Huang <t.huang@acme.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.io>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme.io>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding scheduling + contract inventory: procurement kickoff & technical demo

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the note. We're excited to move forward, but heads up: legal has a standing review on Tue morning so Tue 11/17 AM won't work for us. Wed 11/18 looks better, but Sara and I are tied up 09:00–10:30.

Would Wed 11/18 at 11:00–12:15 or 14:00–15:15 PST work for your team?

Also two asks from procurement/security:
1) Can you share SOC 2 + data handling summary before the kickoff?
2) Our security lead (Elena Gomez) would like to join the technical portion and may request a short separate session focused on network/security integration.

If you can propose a single calendar slot that covers both procurement and the demo, we'll aim to have the contract owner on the call.

Thanks,
Tom Huang
Head of Procurement, Acme Inc.
+1 (650) 555-1789
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Huang <t.huang@acme.io>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.io>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding scheduling + contract inventory: procurement kickoff & technical demo

Thanks Tom — Wed 11/18 works. We can do 11:00–12:15 PST; holding that slot tentatively.

Quick notes / asks before the call:
- We'll send a SOC 2 summary and our vendor questionnaire answers before EOD today.
- Dylan will run the demo; Dylan: can you confirm you can cover model performance, routing/fallback, and data retention controls in a 30-min demo?
- Ben (CS) is copied for timeline and contract logistics — Ben, please confirm whether we should route a draft contract + redlines via DocuSign or share pre-signed MSA for their review.

Proposed prep: 20-min internal prep between AE + SE day-of (30 min before meeting) to align the demo script and call roles. If Acme prefers a separate security deep-dive, we can schedule a follow-up 45-min session next week with our security engineer.

I'll send invites once Dylan confirms.

Best,
Jasmine

> Attachment: Procurement_Checklist.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding scheduling + contract inventory: procurement kickoff & technical demo

Jasmine / team —

I can cover the demo at 11:00–11:45 (30 min demo + 15 min Q&A). My planned outline:
- 5 min: platform overview & deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private)
- 15 min: live demo (generation, streaming, and routing fallbacks)
- 5 min: security & data controls (KV cache, retention, customer-managed keys)
- 5–10 min: Q&A + next steps

A couple of asks for Acme ahead of the demo:
- Will you be able to provide a short sample payload (non-sensitive) and approximate peak qps we should simulate?
- Any blocked ports, IP allowlist requirements, or SSO provider details for the security deep-dive?

I'll prepare a short demo script and share it in the prep folder.

—Dylan
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acme.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Tom Huang <t.huang@acme.io>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme.io>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding scheduling + contract inventory: procurement kickoff & technical demo

Hi all —

Confirming Wed 11/18, 11:00–12:15 PST. I'll join for the technical section and will have our security engineer on the line for a brief run-through of network/SSO requirements.

We will:
- Send vendor questionnaire + SOC 2 summary by EOD today (11/16).
- Provide contract owner contact (legal@acme.io) and expected procurement timeline (2–3 weeks after initial review).
- Request a separate security session (45 min) next week; please propose 3 options and we'll pick one.

Calendar invite ID: zoom.us/meeting/ccf-1234 (please include in the invite)

Thanks,
Elena Gomez
Sr. Security Manager, Acme Inc.
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Huang <t.huang@acme.io>, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acme.io>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.io>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding scheduling + contract inventory: procurement kickoff & technical demo

All — calendar invites sent for Wed 11/18 11:00–12:15 PST (combined procurement + demo). Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210. Prep call (AE+SE) scheduled 11/18 at 10:30 PST — invite to SE and AE only.

Next steps checklist:
- Redwood: share SOC 2 summary + procurement questionnaire answers (EOD 11/16) — ATTACHED (Procurement_Checklist.pdf).
- Acme: confirm contract owner (legal@acme.io) and expected procurement cadence — noted as 2–3 weeks.
- Acme/Security: send any allowlist/SSO details and sample payload ahead of demo (by 11/17 EOD).
- Redwood: prepare demo script and test dataset (we will only request non-sensitive sample data).
- DocuSign: Ben will prepare a redline-friendly MSA and route via DocuSign; expect initial link within 48 hours after kickoff.

If anything changes I'll update the invite. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
